title: Reversed and paid invoices count toward a term's holders, estimates never
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A is held by no customer or vendor today. It was used by three invoices (one paid, one reversed and one open) and by an estimate that was never invoiced; the customer was then moved to Net 30.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Hover "Edit".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Edit" and "Delete Credit Term" are greyed.

Step 2:

  • The hover reads "Used by 3 invoices" (paid, reversed and open count; the estimate does not).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • Terminology: “In use → A term is in use when at least one customer, vendor or invoice (work order or part sale invoice) holds it. Vendor invoices, deliveries and vendor credits store no term, so they never count. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer or vendor with a blank term counts as COD. Every invoice ever created counts, including reversed and paid ones; estimates never count. Customers and vendors count and are listed whatever their status.”
  • S2-R2: “"{holders}" names only the holder types the term has, each with its count, singular or plural: for example "Used by 1 customer and 2 vendors", "Used by 12 customers, 3 vendors and 40 invoices", "Used by 5 invoices".”
